title: IDWTD(I don't want to die)
description:
Leave the game when you are unhealthy.
It's helpful when you are in minecraft smp servers, or afk in single game. Auto leave the game quickly so that you have more chance of surviving. It's easy to set this client-side mod in setting gui.
body: Leave the server when your health is low. It's useful in SMP servers like 2b2t. You can edit the threshold of leaving the game in setting gui. It's possible to set leave health and leave delay. The mod doesn't need much performance.
